sections.text_helper: Section 72.3.3 "USB2 OTG high-speed Port 2 interrupts" in chapter 72 (USB subsystem (USBSS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3754.
sections.section_content:
The USB2 OTG high-speed Port 2 generates one interrupt and one wake-up event, which
can be used to take the system out of Stop mode.
